rationale: The Latin anchors *sepes* (hedge/fence) and the biblical phrase *exi in vias et sepes* ("go out into the roads and hedges", Luke 14:23) unambiguously point to a physical barrier or enclosure. The sense of OE *hege* as a hedge or fence enclosing an area matches fence.n.01 perfectly; fence.n.02 (a dealer in stolen goods) is entirely inapplicable.
